office: the Ministry of Interior's Directorate General of Personal Status, through the mayor (mukhtar) of the civil census location

routes.label: applied for through the mayor of one's civil census location: two months

note: The Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada's response (2016): the application, signed and fingerprinted, goes to the Ministry through the mayor of the applicant's civil census location; processing takes two months; the fee is 5,000 Lebanese pounds. That is the latest fee found; the card's term isn't stated.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Lebanon: Information on national ID cards, individual and family registers (July 2016), on ecoi.net
sources.said: The application must be submitted at the Ministry by the Mayor of the applicant’s Civil Census location The Mayor in turn will submit the application on behalf of the applicant The processing time is two months The fee is 5000 Lebanese Pounds (LBP) [C$4.25]
